title: Fake DARPA guest exposed by an email from DARPA's security manager

tellings.quote: there was that Darper dude that I had on turned out to not be from DARPA because I got a [ __ ] email from DARPA. I got emailed by the security manager of DARPA. He was like, "I'm really sorry to email you, but we've just seen your video and this guy has never worked for DARPA."

plain: A guest who claimed to come from DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, turned out never to have worked there. Jay Anderson, a researcher of ancient mysteries who had interviewed the man, called Michael, says DARPA's security manager emailed him after seeing the video: "I'm really sorry to email you, but we've just seen your video and this guy has never worked for DARPA." Anderson tells it on the show as a lesson about guests who claim inside credentials.
